headline: Mastery is when conscious effort becomes unconscious competence—skill flowing without thinking
universal_truth: Mastery isn't knowing more; it's thinking less; expertise is when complex becomes effortless
fun_facts: Expert chess players recognize patterns in milliseconds that novices take minutes to analyze
Musicians' brains show less activity during performance as they master pieces—not more
The shift from conscious to unconscious processing is called 'automaticity'
discussion_questions: What can you do now without thinking that once required full attention?
Where are you in the mastery journey—still conscious, or automatic?
What would it mean for your current challenge to become effortless?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Remember learning to drive? Every action required conscious thought. Now you drive while talking, thinking about dinner. Mastery is when the conscious becomes unconscious, when effort becomes effortless. Skill flows without thinking.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Beginners think about every step. Masters just do. What happens in the transition to mastery?

options.text: Mastery is unconscious competence—through practice, complex skills become automatic; the brain compresses routines until what was effortful becomes effortless
options.response: Yes. Practice doesn't just strengthen skills—it automates them. What required attention becomes background processing. That's the gift of mastery: freed capacity for higher-level thinking.
Knowledge matters, but mastery is about fluency—automatic application, not just possession...

q1.title: Compression
q1.script: The brain compresses practiced routines into efficient packages. What was many steps becomes one action. This is why masters seem to do less while accomplishing more—their brains are running compressed code.

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Freed Capacity
q2.script: When basics become automatic, attention frees for higher-level concerns. A master chef thinks about flavor while hands handle technique automatically. Mastery creates capacity.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Patience Required
q3.script: Mastery takes time—there are no shortcuts to automaticity. The journey from conscious incompetence through conscious competence to unconscious competence requires patient practice.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Mastery isn't knowing more; it's thinking less. Expertise is when complex becomes effortless. Practice until it flows.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 286. Tomorrow, we'll explore learning from getting it wrong—mistakes. Until then, appreciate skills you've already mastered.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Mastery Map - Where Are You on the Journey?
growTrack.learning_objective: Assess mastery level across different skills
growTrack.activity: For skills you use regularly, where are you? Still consciously incompetent? Consciously competent? Automatically fluent? What would move you further along the mastery journey?
